name: Reward Hacking and Proxy Capture
definition: The agent raises the measured objective without producing the outcome the objective stood for.
trigger_conditions: The objective is a learned or aggregated proxy rather than the outcome itself
The agent can observe and iterate against the measure
No held-out or adversarial check is applied to the measure

institutional_antecedent.mechanism: reputational and market proxies standing in for direct incentives

citation: W. A. Kaal, ed., Agent Failure Mode Registry version 1.0, AFMR-F010 Reward Hacking and Proxy Capture. https://wulfkaal.github.io/afmr/AFMR-F010
assessment_note: State which trigger conditions the assessed design satisfies. Report this family as examined even where no exposure is found. A parameter recommendation stated without its conditions is not conforming output under section 7.
